name: @beauclick/referral-contract
description: The browser-safe half of the referral contract: the code alphabet and length, the invite path segment, the share payload shape, and the closed share-channel vocabulary. Zero dependencies, no framework, no TypeORM -- so the Next.js bundle and the NestJS server share ONE definition instead of two that drift. Deliberately carries NO reward value, point total, cap, or attribution vocabulary (Stories #12, #27, #28).
